wire.t: Waivers ran overnight. TJohn91 claimed Audric Estime for The Champ with a $2 bid and dropped Matt Hibner. It was the only waiver claim of the week.
Audric Estime had 15 carries for 72 yards and a touchdown in his Saints debut, a 23-22 overtime win over Cleveland, and his 16 touches led the team. New Orleans plays Carolina in Week 10.

Josh Jacobs fractured his right ring finger in Green Bay's win over New England, and Matt LaFleur called his Week 10 availability against Minnesota uncertain. Sleeper lists him Out, and TJohn91 has already moved him out of The Champ’s lineup. Kaleb Johnson led the Packers with 14 carries for 68 yards; he's on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte's bench.

Miami put Malik Willis on injured reserve with a core muscle injury, and Kyle McCord will make his first NFL start at Indianapolis in Week 10. Willis is on LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix's bench behind Josh Allen and Jordan Love.

JAY2913 picked up Kyle McCord for OBJAY at 6:43 AM ET and dropped Tua Tagovailoa, who scored -0.64 total in nine weeks on the OBJAY bench. Earlier: Corey Kiner in for Cade Klubnik, Laquon Treadwell in and out in 93 seconds for Tutu Atwell, and Gardner Minshew II dropped Tuesday night.

Puka Nacua has MCL and PCL sprains plus turf toe, won't play in Week 10 and is likely headed to IR. With the Rams' Week 11 bye, Week 15 is the earliest he can return. TheMoneyTeam2302 has already benched him on Hold My DK.

Week 10 byes are Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay. As of Wednesday morning, Catfan94’s Farm Team still has four starters on those teams, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte and Dude, Your Getting a Dell each have one.

stories.title: The Champ spends $2 on Audric Estime, OBJAY beats everybody to Kyle McCord, and Hold My DK loses Puka Nacua
stories.dek: One waiver claim, five free-agent moves before sunrise and a Week 10 that just got harder for an 8‑1 team.
body: The only waiver claim this week went to TJohn91, who paid $2 for Audric Estime and dropped Matt Hibner. Estime had 15 carries for 72 yards and a touchdown in his first game for New Orleans, and Josh Jacobs is listed Out with a fractured finger. The Champ is 4‑5 with a 59-40 all-play record, and that's the kind of cheap move a team like that should make.

JAY2913 was up early. OBJAY added Laquon Treadwell, cut him 93 seconds later for Tutu Atwell, swapped Cade Klubnik for Corey Kiner, then dropped Tua Tagovailoa for Kyle McCord. That last one is a good move: Malik Willis went on IR Tuesday, McCord starts at Indianapolis, and Bo Nix is on bye. In a superflex league, a starting quarterback is a starting quarterback, and Tua had -0.64 points total on OBJAY's bench this season.

The bad news is at the top. Puka Nacua scored 32.5 in Week 9 for Hold My DK, and now he's out for Week 10 and likely headed to IR with MCL and PCL sprains and turf toe. Week 15 is the earliest he can come back. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 8‑1, owns no first-round picks through 2029, and has to keep winning without his best receiver. The line against StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte drops from 41.2 to 35.2.

And Bill_Buttlicker? Kaleb Johnson had 14.3 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench in Week 9 and led Green Bay in rushing, while Makai Lemon is in the lineup on Philadelphia's bye week. Tyler has until Sunday to fix that, and he's been told.

stories.title: Week 9 recap: Catfan94’s Farm Team drops 180.30, The Champ loses with the highest losing score, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑9
stories.dek: A 97.38-point blowout, a 6.28-point nail-biter and three starters below zero.
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 82.92, a 97.38-point margin and the biggest of the week. Kenneth Walker III had 36.8, Brock Purdy 31.28, Christian Watson 28.6 and Bucky Irving 27.5. jrsmith1391 is 6‑3 and has won two straight.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat The Champ 164.84 to 127.74. Jordan Love scored 42.18, Ja'Marr Chase 30.0 and Brock Bowers 24.3, and Catfan94 is 8‑1 with five wins in a row. TJohn91 had the highest losing score of the week and still lost by 37.10. Josh Jacobs scored -0.5 in the lineup, and Boutte (29.5) and Matthew Stafford (13.22) sat on the bench.

Hold My DK beat Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 86.20 behind Puka Nacua at 32.5 and Christian McCaffrey at 23.7. Kraft for Cash beat I Chase Brown Kids 121.74 to 99.86, and Asian Jim beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 68.34, which is the lowest score of the week. Br0phy is 0‑9.

StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte beat OBJAY 115.16 to 108.88 by 6.28, the closest game of the week. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑6 with Drake Maye at 24.76. JAY2913 had Efton Chism III on the bench with 14.4, and swapping him in for Emeka Egbuka (6.4) would have won it 116.88 to 115.16.

stories.title: Bye week hits Catfan94’s Farm Team and OBJAY hardest, and The Champ is a 64.1-point favorite
stories.dek: Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay are off, and the lines already know.
body: Four teams are on bye in Week 10: Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay. Catfan94’s Farm Team has Swift, Irving, Loveland and Mayfield in its lineup on those teams, which is four starters out against OBJAY, who is missing Nix, Egbuka and Burden III. The line is Catfan94’s Farm Team by 22.6.

The biggest spread is The Champ by 64.1 over Dude, Your Getting a Dell, whose Goedert is off and whose Rhamondre Stevenson is listed Doubtful. The Champ is without Josh Jacobs, so those cancel out. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is a 40.4-point favorite over Jefferson’s Reserve, and Hold My DK is now a 35.2-point favorite over StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte with Puka Nacua out, where Bill_Buttlicker has Jalen Hurts on IR and Philadelphia’s receivers on bye.
The closest game on the board is Kraft for Cash by 12.5 over Asian Jim. I Chase Brown Kids is favored over Bourbon Lover by 19.7, with Courtland Sutton on bye for paknight12.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks, and four contenders own none
stories.dek: The picks through 2029 are lopsided, and the standings are too.
body: Counting 2027 through 2029, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte owns 12 first-round picks, which is a full first round's worth of picks. JAY2913 is next with six on OBJAY, then ZachCarroll09 with five on I Chase Brown Kids and Br0phy with four on Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

Kraft for Cash, Catfan94’s Farm Team, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK own zero first-round picks over that stretch, and they are the top four teams in the standings. That's a bet on now, and it's working while the whole group is 6‑3 or better.
The risk is that all four teams are on the wrong side of a rebuild in three years, and the one with 12 first-round picks is 3‑6 with 27-72 all-play. Tyler's plan is a long one.

columns.title: OBJAY lost by 6.28 and the answer was on the bench
columns.dek: Efton Chism III had 14.4, Emeka Egbuka had 6.4.
body: JAY2913 lost 115.16 to 108.88. Efton Chism III had 14.4 on the bench and Emeka Egbuka had 6.4 in the lineup. That's an 8.0-point swing, and the game was a 6.28-point gap.
That's not bad luck. That's a lineup decision. You are 4‑5 now. You can be 5‑4.
Now it's a bye week and Nix, Egbuka and Burden III are all off. Check the lineup Saturday, JAY2913. Then check it again.

columns.title: 4 waiver-wire tips from Holden McGroin, who once bid $100 on a kicker in Week 16
columns.dek: Wednesday is for picking people up. Holden is for picking up bad habits.
body: 1. Bid $2 on everybody. TJohn91 bid $2 on Audric Estime and got a guy who led the Saints with 16 touches. If $2 works once, $2 works always. That's science.
2. Hold every player for at least 93 seconds. JAY2913 kept Laquon Treadwell for exactly that long. Any shorter and it's a crush, not a commitment.
3. Never pick up a quarterback who's starting. Kyle McCord starts for Miami this week, and JAY2913 grabbed him anyway. Real strategists wait until a guy's benched, so you get him cheap.

4. Keep your bye-week players in the lineup out of loyalty. Bill_Buttlicker has Makai Lemon starting on Philadelphia's bye and Kaleb Johnson (14.3 last week) on the bench. I respect it. Tyler doesn't, and he's the one who has to look at it.

columns.title: Audric Estime is worth 36 yards per dollar
columns.dek: The Champ paid $2, OBJAY paid 93 seconds, and I measured both.
body: TJohn91 paid $2 for Audric Estime, who ran for 72 yards in his Saints debut. That's 36 rushing yards per FAAB dollar, which my model rates as the most efficient purchase in league history, because I only started measuring this morning.

Laquon Treadwell was on OBJAY for 93 seconds. Tutu Atwell has been there for more than two and a half hours, which is over 100 times as long. By my math, JAY2913's commitment to wide receivers is up 10,000%, and I didn't round much.

Tua Tagovailoa scored -0.64 points in nine weeks on OBJAY's bench, which is -0.07 per week. Kyle McCord has scored 0.00 for OBJAY. That's a 0.07-point weekly upgrade before he's taken a snap, and it's my favorite stat of the season.
Puka Nacua scored 32.5 of Hold My DK's 147.12 in Week 9, which is 22.1%. TheMoneyTeam2302 now has to replace 22.1% of a team. My spreadsheet says that's about one Puka Nacua.

Scored 25.0 on the bench for a team that won 147.12 to 86.20. Hold My DK is deep, and he's one of the extras.
Scored 16.48 on the bench for a team with Josh Allen, Jordan Love and Malik Willis ahead of him. Wants a starting job somewhere.
